contact_meta_description: Contact Happy Farmhouse in Waterford or Toronto. We are happy to assist you in English or Chinese.
contact_hero_description: Have a question about our farm or products? We'd love to hear from you. Reach out to one of our locations below.
contact_section_description: Choose the contact that works best for you.
contact_chinese_note: Before 5:30 PM, please text. After 5:30 PM, please call.
contact_wechat_note: Please contact us for WeChat details.
contact_cta_title: We Look Forward to Hearing From You!
contact_cta_description: Whether you have questions about our produce or want to learn more about our farm, we're happy to help.
contact_footer_description: Bringing fresh, naturally grown produce to our community.
products_meta_description: Discover our naturally grown farm produce, including butternut squash, kabocha squash, and seasonal vegetables.
products_butternut_description: Naturally sweet with a smooth, creamy texture and a slightly nutty flavour. Perfect for hearty soups, oven roasting, and homemade baking.
products_kabocha_description: A Japanese winter squash with rich orange flesh, a naturally sweet flavour, and a soft, fluffy texture. Delicious roasted, steamed, or added to soups.
products_green_beans_description: Fresh, crisp green beans with a mild, slightly sweet flavour. Enjoy them steamed, sautéed, or added to your favourite dishes.
products_hero_description: Good food starts with good growing practices. Explore our selection of fresh, naturally grown vegetables, straight from our farm to your table.
products_available_description: Discover our carefully grown selection of fresh produce.
products_upcoming_description: Here's a little preview of what's coming to our farm next season.
products_footer_description: Our produce is grown without synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or fertilizers, with a focus on natural growing practices and quality.
